judgement.reason: Remark42 stores all comments in an embedded local data file with no PostgreSQL or MySQL option, and Deployz provides no persistent disk.

evidence.quote: * No external databases, everything embedded in a single data file

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ./var:/srv/var (docker-compose.yml remark)
reviews.reason: Remark42 keeps comments and uploaded images in an embedded data file under /srv/var, and none of the shown lines select PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis or S3 for that data, so it needs durable local storage.
